subject: Tri-party co-sell demo: StratusWorks / AWS / Redwood — HelixPilot walkthrough
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@stratusworks.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv.menon@aws-partners.amazon.com, leo.tan@helixpilot.com
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tri-party demo for HelixPilot — coordinating windows

Hi Sean / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth on the phone earlier. StratusWorks and HelixPilot are excited to run a co-sell demo with AWS and Redwood focused on the HelixPilot integration (customer-facing, ~35 minute session + 10 minute Q&A). High level asks:

- Confirm a 45-minute slot (30-min product walkthrough + 15-min Q&A / next-steps).
- Need AWS SA (Rajiv) to cover marketplace listing and procurement Q&A.
- Redwood to demo the runtime economics (latency/cost) and show the Dedicated fallback behavior.

Time windows that work for the StratusWorks + HelixPilot teams (PDT):
- Option A: Sep 16, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Sep 16, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Option C: Sep 17, 08:30–09:15 PT (HelixPilot prefers earlier slot)

Can you confirm which of those work for Redwood and whether you want us to host the call or you will (we can hand off presenter controls). Also, can you share any preflight ops checklist we should follow for network and account link demos? I can circulate a short runbook if helpful.

Thanks — looping in Rajiv and Leo.

Best,
Emily Hart
Head of Partnerships, StratusWorks
[attachment: partnership_onepager.pdf (PDF, 84KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@stratusworks.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo for HelixPilot — coordinating windows

Emily — thanks for the clear options. Happy to run this. Quick notes inline and a couple of asks:

- We prefer Redwood to host (gives us control of streaming + model variant toggles). Hosting from us-west-2 is fine.
- 45 minutes works; we typically structure it as 20-min product flow (HelixPilot + StratusWorks), 15-min Redwood runtime demo (including Dedicated fallback and batching economics), 10-min open Q&A.

Availability from our side (PT):
- Sep 16, 10:00–10:45 — AVAILABLE (preferred)
- Sep 16, 13:00–13:45 — OK as fallback
- Sep 17, 08:30–09:15 — limited (HelixPilot overlap looks tight)

Asks / preflight items:
1) HelixPilot: can you provide a small anonymized sample dataset or demo tenant that we can exercise during the run? (CSV or S3 link).
2) Technical: we need outbound connectivity to HelixPilot's test endpoint and a pre-shared demo API key (expires after the rehearsal).
3) Ops: attaching a draft runbook for the session (redwood_runbook_v1.pdf) — please review and flag anything missing.

Vanessa / Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm you can join the session and whether you want to run a 30-min dry run the day before?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-09T13:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo for HelixPilot — coordinating windows

Hi Emily / Sean — good plan. Quick availability + ops notes: 

- I'm available Sep 16, 10:00–10:45 PT and can host the dry run on Sep 15 at 11:00 PT for 30 minutes.
- Karthik, can you lead the network/account link checklist on the dry run? I can take presenter controls for the Redwood runtime demo.

Ops checklist highlights (from our side):
- Confirm redwood_runbook_v1.pdf items: staging tenant, demo API key, and webhook endpoints.
- Confirm whether HelixPilot requires any inbound firewall rules for model callbacks — if so please share IP CIDR.
- We recommend a short tear-down script post-demo to invalidate the demo API key.

Fallback plan: if live HelixPilot integration has latency or credential issues, we'll pre-record the segment and label it as a live replay; still leave 10 minutes for Q&A and procurement discussion with Rajiv.

Attaching an ops checklist matrix (demo-ops-checklist.xlsx).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Perfect — Sep 16, 10:00–10:45 PT works for all internal parties. Rajiv confirmed he can join and will cover marketplace procurement / listing questions. HelixPilot will provide a demo tenant S3 link by EOD Monday and the demo API key ahead of the dry run.

I'll send a calendar invite (attached: helix_cal-invite.ics) with the presenter roster and the proposed run order. Please accept and let me know if any changes are needed. We'll plan the dry run Sep 15, 11:00 PT (30 minutes) — calendar will include that as a separate invite.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Emily Hart
Head of Partnerships, StratusWorks
